svg.title: Configs name runtimes; runs travel through the store
svg.desc: On the robot computer, a workcell config names a runtime (remote: runtime robot); the machine's execution profile resolves it to a venv and environment variables. hylo serve workcell records episodes as runs in the robot's store. The workstation pulls runs it does not have, and pushes artifacts such as a judge or a memory back. Sealed artifacts are never overwritten.
